patterns: APPSC asks title-to-ruler single facts: Tripura-Martya-Maheswara = Gunaga Vijayaditya; 108 Saiva temples; Kandukuru developed as Bezawada = Vijayaditya III.
Chola-Vengi matrimonial ties are a recurring stem (Cholas' close relations with the Chalukyas of Vengi).
Jain patronage by queens (Ayyana Mahadevi, Nedumba Vasati) and inscriptions (Bezwada 885 CE) are asked at G1/G2 level.
Keys in this topic are often shaky (Vijayaditya I vs II, Ayyana Mahadevi's husband) - stick to standard history.
App MCQs go far deeper (marriages, Koppam, inscription tables, temple styles) than the PYQs; several hinge on 'as per key' disputes.
